slice: Natural conversation round 6: fix 'i'm <state>' misread as an introduction

real_llm_before_fix.i'm feeling tired today: Feeling Tired Today — nice to put a name to you. I'll remember that.

real_llm_after_fix.i'm feeling tired today: I hear you — tired can settle in deep. I'm feeling that too sometimes...

mechanism: _extract_self_name rejects state/action words after 'i'm'/'i am' and requires a plausible 1-3-word alphabetic name, so 'i'm tired today' is treated as a status, not an introduction
